card.name: Words around eGFR kidney thresholds
card.fires_on: Small words right after eGFR or estimated glomerular filtration rate, such as 'than' in 'eGFR less than', '=' or an opening parenthesis. Also the 'M' that starts MDRD.

modes.label: Threshold wording
modes.description: The word 'than' after 'eGFR less' just before a number such as 30 or 45.
modes.example: SYNJARDY and SYNJARDY XR are contraindicated in patients with an eGFR less<< than>> 30 mL/min/1.

modes.label: Abbreviation lead-in
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or equals sign that introduces or defines the eGFR abbreviation.
modes.example: an estimated glomerular filtration rate<< (>>eGFR). Sitagliptin

modes.label: MDRD equation
modes.description: The first letter of MDRD in the name of the eGFR equation.
modes.example: As calculated using the<< M>>DRD eGFR equation as follows

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mixed and mostly unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It fires on the small words that sit next to eGFR kidney function values, such as 'less than' before a cutoff.
